_source: Sub-topics from the published GSSSB Class-3 CCE, GPSSB Talati-cum-Mantri and GPSC Prelims syllabi.

languages.gu: simple, everyday Gujarati written in Gujarati script (ગુજરાતી લિપિ)
languages.hi: simple, everyday Hindi written in Devanagari script (देवनागरी)

question_styles: statement-based: "Which of the following statements is correct / NOT correct?"
match the pairs, with at most two pairs in each option

gk.area: General Knowledge for Gujarat government exams
subtopics: Indian Constitution: Preamble, Fundamental Rights and Duties, Directive Principles
Panchayati Raj: 73rd Amendment, Gram Panchayat, Gram Sabha, Taluka and District Panchayat
Indian freedom movement and Gandhiji (Dandi March, Champaran, Quit India)
History of Gujarat: Solanki and Maitraka dynasties, Sultanate, formation of Gujarat in 1960
Culture of Gujarat: fairs (Tarnetar, Vautha, Bhavnath), folk dances, festivals, handicrafts
Geography of Gujarat: districts, rivers, dams, ports, national parks and sanctuaries
Geography of India: rivers, mountains, states and capitals, soils, crops
General Science: human body, nutrition and diseases, basic physics and chemistry in daily life
Indian economy basics: banks, RBI, budget, GST, agriculture schemes
Computer basics: hardware, software, MS Office, internet, shortcut keys
data interpretation from a small table

reasoning.area: Reasoning Ability (verbal and non-verbal, written as text)

gujarati.area: Gujarati Grammar and Literature (ગુજરાતી વ્યાકરણ અને સાહિત્ય)

current.area: Gujarat and India general awareness (schemes, institutions, important days, sports, awards)
subtopics: major Government of Gujarat welfare schemes
science and space missions of India
